body: Hello staff Avicus about five minutes ago I was banned because the moderator was left seeing fly thought I had the hack ie the fly but I assure you that I am not using more hacks since I 've unbanned . I have a connection that is worthwhile and at that time I was launched from the roof and I had started Lagging . I was hanging in the air , and the moderator was believed that I had the fly so I was banned. I do not see the reason to use hacks as they are already been banned once . Kindly could be unbanned please find it just be banned for nothing. Please please let me raise your ban , please do me this gift I'm not using more hacks. GuyNamedRiley not my fault that i have a line that is worth. Thanks for reading.
